verdict.rationale: Twilio documents a real-time feed of all its events streamed to multiple destinations (docs-8) and programmatic handling of incoming calls (docs-23). A hands-on user confirms they still use Twilio for voicemail-to-webhook with transcription (comm-15), but the pack never explicitly documents registering webhook URLs for call and message events. Missing for 10: first-party docs on registrable webhook callbacks for voice and messaging status and inbound events, documentation that HTTP webhooks are an Event Streams destination type, and evidence covering message (SMS) event webhooks specifically.
